description: Use this before changing an asset with edit_asset, or when the user asks what one looks like: one the user saved (asset_id) or a set or design you made in this conversation (handle). Returns its screens, each with its background, its layers bottom first (text, pictures and the phone, each with an id, a position as a share of the canvas and its style) and its loop if it is animated, plus warnings about what may look off, and a preview image of each screen. Also returns the revision edit_asset needs. With asset_id (something the user saved) it needs the user signed in to appdesigns (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves); with handle (a set or design you made in this conversation, not saved yet) it needs no sign-in. Read-only.

handle.description: Instead of asset_id: the project_handle create_project returned or the design_handle create_design returned, for something you made in this conversation that the user has not saved yet. Needs no sign-in.

previews.description: Which screens to preview, from 1. Default: all of them.

name: get_asset
title: Read one asset
